litigation.note: The Directors' Report states that no significant or material orders were passed by any regulator, court or tribunal during the year impacting the going concern status or future operations, and that no applications were filed against the Company under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The Company is itself the claimant in one matter: as an Operational Creditor it filed Company Petition C.P. (IB) No. 209 of 2024 against M/s. Splenora Textures LLP before the NCLT, Ahmedabad Bench under Section 9 of the IBC. The Corporate Debtor repaid the entire outstanding principal in a phased manner during the year; interest claimed on the delayed payment remains outstanding and unreceived, and the Company is continuing adjudication before the NCLT, where the matter is pending. The Company also states it has not entered into any one-time settlement with any bank or financial institution.

risks.note: The Directors' Report states the textile industry witnessed a challenging business environment 'due to fluctuations in cotton prices'. Cotton is the Company's sole raw material - it manufactures only cotton yarn - so the input price cycle passes directly through the cost base; the cautionary statement separately names 'availability of critical materials and their cost' as a factor that could influence operations.

'changing demand patterns' is named alongside cotton prices as a feature of the challenged FY26 environment; the cautionary statement adds 'global and domestic demand and supply conditions affecting selling prices'.
Explicitly named by the Board as part of the challenging FY26 business environment; the cautionary statement also lists 'economic development of the country' as a material factor.

The Company's own cautionary statement names 'new capacity additions' among the important factors that could influence operations - a structural spinning-sector overcapacity risk. PROVENANCE: the cautionary statement is routed to the profile / governance_entities sibling bundles, not to this risks bundle.
risks.risk: Industry capacity additions compressing selling prices

risks.note: 'changes in government policies and tax laws' is named in the cautionary statement as a factor material to operations - relevant given the sector's dependence on schemes such as MSP cotton procurement, TUFS, SITP and MITRA Parks. PROVENANCE: cautionary statement, sibling bundle.

Demonstrated, not hypothetical: the Company had to pursue an Operational Creditor petition (C.P. (IB) No. 209 of 2024) against M/s. Splenora Textures LLP before the NCLT Ahmedabad Bench under Section 9 of the IBC to recover an outstanding operational debt. The principal was repaid in a phased manner during the year, but the interest claimed on delayed payment remains outstanding and unreceived, and adjudication continues.

The Annual Report describes one manufacturing facility only - the Greenfield unit at Village Dholi, Taluka Dholka, District Ahmedabad, Gujarat - so any disruption at that site would affect all production. No second plant, no alternate site and no product capacity figure is disclosed anywhere in the routed text. PROVENANCE: the facility description is in the Corporate Overview, routed to the profile / registry / capex sibling bundles.

The Corporate Overview states the product range caters to various textile segments 'with a significant focus on the denim industry' - tying a material share of demand to one downstream fabric cycle. No customer-concentration or segment-share percentage is disclosed. PROVENANCE: Corporate Overview, sibling bundle.
